scope: All 54 recorded accepted upstream repositories, including adopted-only TD-MPC2; Genesis-Embodied-AI is excluded. All accessible current default-branch heads were freshly checked.
method: Read current default-branch HEAD through the commits endpoint with sha omitted. Retain previously complete counts only when pinned HEAD is identical; otherwise enumerate author=Afloat16 commits at the newly pinned SHA until a terminal page with fewer than 100 entries and deduplicate SHA. All returned author logins were Afloat16. Includes authored merge commits, distinct from Contributors graph counts and merged PRs.
